content:
maria: Quick flag — bringup of q4b-int8 v2026-03 shows a 12% drop on rare-intent slice of promptset-longtail. dashboard: https://console.redwood/models/q4b-int8/metrics/178320
aj: Which metric/benchmark? precision/recall or embed-recall?
maria: Mainly F1 drop on our golden microset and lower embedding recall for paraphrase anchors. See delta in eval/regression table (summary pasted below).
thomas: Could be tokenization/hash shift after quant kernels. I saw mismatch when running tokenizer v2 vs v3 on the same prompts.
sara: Label ops: we have ~200 label slots/day this week. Can do a microgolden of ~1k in 5 days if prioritized.
maria: Proposal: 1) run dedupe using tokenizer v3 and v2 side-by-side 2) sample 2k potential edgecases (long-context, code, list prompts) 3) run labeling microgolden for 1k prioritizing rare intents 4) add 150 high-leak anchors to golden set 5) canary rollout with auto-fallback.
aj: Sounds good. Rollback criteria? and where do we run the bulk eval?
maria: Rollback if microgolden F1 drops >5% vs baseline or embed-recall drop >7% on anchors. Bulk eval runs on bench infra: bench-runner01 (internal). Command I used locally:

```
./scripts/eval_onboard.sh \
  --model q4b-int8:v2026-03 \
  --prompts data/promptset-longtail/ \
  --tokenizer v3 \
  --out results/q4b-v2026-03.json
```

thomas: I will run a tokenizer parity pass and produce a dedupe manifest. Will try both v2/v3 hash functions and include token-length distrib. ETA: EOD PST.
sara: I'll reserve labeler capacity and spin up a microgolden queue. Can we prioritize examples flagged by the dedupe manifest and by discriminator score <0.4?
maria: Yes. Prioritize by (low discriminator score, high perplexity, long ctx). Put list in: drive/curation/edgecases/178320
labeling-bot: microgolden job scheduled: job_id=mg-178320-ab12, samples=1000, start_ts=1783210000, priority=high
aj: Also need ops to patch serving fallback: if latency SLO met but quality regressions detected, fallback to float16 model automatically. I'll open an infra PR.
thomas: I'll add a quick hash-stable dedupe script to repo: tools/dedupe/tokenhash_stable.py and output a manifest like:
```
manifest = [
  {"sample_id": "s123", "tokens_v2": 124, "tokens_v3": 130, "duplicate": false},
]
```
(note: that's the shape, actual file will be CSV for labelers)
maria: Thanks — once we have the manifest + microgolden results, we'll decide canary timing. Target: canary in 48h after labels land.
sara: ack. I'll post daily progress updates in this thread and ping if capacity shifts.
aj: I'll add automatic fallback policy to the rollout config and wire the regression alerts to console-alerts.
maria: One more ask — capture a small sample of failed examples for quant-smoke repo (quant-smoke/issues) with exact token sequences so model team can repro.
thomas: Will include token dumps and mini repro harness.
labeling-bot: microgolden job update: queued (waiting for manifest). Will attach results and link here when done.
maria: Great work — keeping this thread as the single source for curation/labels/canary decision. :thumbsup:
aj: +1 :rocket:
sara: :raised_hands:
